Classic NES Series - Zelda II - The Adve.name: Classic NES Series: Zelda II - The Adventure of Link
Classic NES Series - Zelda II - The Adve.summary: Zelda II: The Adventure of Link is an action role-playing game, and a sequel to The Legend Of Zelda. The gameplay alternates between a top-down view (when traveling the land) and side-scrolling perspectives (when fighting, in a temple, or town). In the top-down view, Link cannot do much except for walking: in the side-scrolling action view, however, he can fight, cast spells, collect items and talk to people.

Dan Doh!! Tobase Shouri no Smile Shot.name: Dan Doh!! Tobase Shouri no Smile Shot
Dan Doh!! Tobase Shouri no Smile Shot.summary: Dan Doh!! Tobase Shouri no Smile Shot is the second game based on the golf manga "Dan Doh!!"

Hamster Monogatari Collection.name: Hamster Monogatari Collection
Hamster Monogatari Collection.summary: Hamster Monogatari Collection is a Miscellaneous game, published by Culture Brain, which was released in Japan in 2003.

Minna no Soft Series - Tetris Advance.name: Minna no Soft Series: Tetris Advance
Minna no Soft Series - Tetris Advance.summary: Minna no Soft Series: Tetris Advance, known in-game simply as Tetris Advance, is a falling-block puzzle game. Part of Success's Minna no Soft series, Tetris Advance includes the standard game of Tetris along with a mission-based "Challenge" mode that tasks players with completing specific objectives (such as erasing lines, or clearing an entire board with a certain piece arrangement). It also includes linked Single-Pak Multiplayer support for up to four players.

Pac-Man Collection.name: Pac-Man Collection
Pac-Man Collection.summary: One of the first video games ever created, PAC-MAN still happens to be one of the best, as well. This comprehensive collection includes three unique Pac-Man titles in one complete package. Inside you'll find the original Pac-Man which has you traversing mazes, avoiding deadly ghosts, and chomping down nutritious dots; Pac-Mania is a 3D take on the first version, in which you can actually jump over the ghosts; and Pac-Attack is a Tetris-like experience that'll have you lining up blocks in a fast-paced environment.

Shaman King - Master of Spirits 2.name: Shonen Jump's Shaman King: Master of Spirits 2
Shaman King - Master of Spirits 2.summary: Sequel to the original Shaman King: Master of Spirits, you once again take the role of Yoh Asakura as you attempt to save all your friends and fellow shamans from Zeke's Fire Spirit, who is devouring the soul of everyone in Dobie Village, where the Shaman Tournament is to take place.

Space Twins.name: Space Twins
Space Twins.summary: Experience the thrilling universe of Space Twins for the Game Boy Advance, an action-packed adventure released in 2003. With its captivating gameplay and unique mechanics, this unknown title promises to transport players into a captivating space odyssey. Join forces and explore the cosmos in this intriguing and rare ROM that appeals to both collectors and action game enthusiasts alike.

Tales of the World - Summoner's Lineage.name: Tales of the World: Summoner's Lineage
Tales of the World - Summoner's Lineage.summary: A spin-off of the Tales series set in the Tales of Phantasia universe.
